metadata.boundary: Same resident encoded bytes to independent coded source metadata and complete pixel-coding validation. Managed required decoder storage, native libavcodec natural frame and original source-metadata adapter, all cleanup included. No RGBA normalization, caller pixel output/copy, reorientation, cached descriptor, IPC or real I/O. Async includes fresh nonseekable source, actual acquisition/growth/EOF and release. live.note: Contemporary standalone live intervals overlap; the larger ALC gain remains scoped to that context. No standalone live gain/closure or cause is inferred. Actual ordinary reference-normalized gain is separated. Every candidate capture is retained, without repeat.

implementation.hypothesis: Header mode parsing still uses Vp8BooleanReader.Read with a bit-at-a-time normalization loop, unlike coefficient decoding's wide buffered/LZCNT normalizer. Reuse the existing exact BlockReader arithmetic for sufficiently long first-partition macroblock mode data; this removes normalization iterations, not merely state-publication bridges.
implementation.endState: One shared macroblock mode tree with scalar/wide value-type selection at entry. The wide path uses existing CancellableBlockReader.Read and keeps every decision poll. Reuse BeginWindow for coefficient/header consumers; rename only the internal old coefficient-specific factory, no forwarding wrapper. No constructor/header-option algorithm change, new heap state, ownership or caches.
implementation.lookahead: A mode macroblock needs at most2segment bits +1skip +3large-mode decisions +16*7small-mode decisions +3chroma =121decisions (conservative, since the three-decision large mode excludes small modes). Each arithmetic decision normalizes by at most7bits. The existing272B/304-decision coefficient-window guard is more than sufficient; derive/preserve declared partition end and refill lookahead. Do not invent a tighter bound merely for this fixture.
implementation.failureBoundary: WebpCodec constructs a private Vp8Decoder for DecodePlanes/ValidatePixels; no public decoder is observed/resumed after failure. Only completed successful state may publish. Preserve scalar truncation fallback, cancellation token identity, exception/cleanup and borrowed caller-root/input ownership.

storage.note: No new buffer/owner/cache/pool/session. Existing coarse header workspace and pixel ownership remain. GC allocations, admitted capacity, active outputs and two-slot/4MiB default idle storage are distinct. Governed calls bypass default idle storage.

correctness.preserved: Per-decision cancellation and token identity, short-header scalar fallback, borrowed root/input, refusal cleanup, retained independent output and successful subsequent operations. Operation-private failed decoder cannot be observed/resumed.
